title: 第1500章 满天遍野的窥探第1499章 秦延军的期待
content_zh:
第1500章满天遍野的窥探
混沌青莲扎根于秦家庄园中心，其莲台之上，那枚混沌莲子并非静止不动。
在秦延军以混沌球之力滋养，加之二十八重天浓郁的天地灵气灌输入下，莲子表面的混沌气流愈发活跃，隐隐有了搏动之象，仿佛一颗沉睡的心脏正在缓缓苏醒。
这一日，秦延军正在推演“世界投影”的更深层运用，忽然心有所感，猛地望向庄园中心。
只见混沌青莲周身的混沌元气如潮水般涌向莲子，莲子表面裂开一道细微的缝隙。
一缕比发丝更纤细的金色光芒从中射出，悬浮于半空，化作一个巴掌大小、通体由混沌元气凝聚而成的孩童虚影。
这虚影懵懂地睁开眼睛，好奇地打量着四周，最后目光落在秦延军身上，奶声奶气地喊了一声：“父……亲？”
秦延军心神剧震，他能清晰地感受到自己与这孩童虚影之间存在着血脉般的联系，更能感知到对方体内那纯粹到极致的混沌本源。
他瞬间明白，这是混沌莲子孕育出的“青莲之灵”，因他长期以混沌球温养，又融入了他的意志，竟真的诞生了灵智！
“从今往后，你便叫‘秦青’。”秦延军温和开口，眼中满是欣慰。
秦青咯咯一笑，化作一道流光融入青莲，青莲的气息顿时暴涨一截，散发出的混沌元气更加精纯，甚至开始自发地梳理庄园周围的天地灵气，形成了一个巨大的灵气旋涡。
秦青的诞生，不仅是多了一个伙伴，更带来了混沌青莲深处的秘密。
随着秦青灵智渐开，他开始断断续续地向秦延军传递一些信息——那是混沌青莲从混沌初开时便记载的记忆碎片。
其中，最珍贵的是一部名为《混沌源典》的功法残卷，并非具体的招式，而是关于“混沌法则”的感悟：如何以自身为混沌，衍化万物；如何以混沌之力破尽万法；如何在毁灭中孕育生机……
秦延军修炼《混沌源典》，古神王境圆满的瓶颈竟隐隐有了松动的迹象。
他坐在青莲之下，周身混沌气流缭绕，时而化作宇宙星辰，时而化作山川草木，体内神力与混沌元气交融，隐隐触摸到了“天尊境”的门槛——那是超越神王境，掌握部分宇宙本源法则的境界！
此外，秦青还告知秦延军，混沌青莲的根茎深处，连接着一条“混沌源河”的支流，若能彻底激活，秦家庄园将拥有源源不断的混沌元气，甚至能演化出一方小世界。
但激活源河，需要“混沌核心”作为钥匙，而这核心，散落在二十八重天的某处远古秘境之中。
混沌青莲的异动，尤其是秦青诞生时逸散的那一缕混沌本源气息，如同在平静的湖面投下巨石，瞬间传遍了整个二十八重天，甚至惊动了更高层次的存在。
在二十八重天极西之地，一片被时空乱流包裹的“混沌古域”中，一群皮肤呈青黑色、背后生有混沌羽翼的族人忽然跪拜在地。

他们是上古混沌大战后幸存的“混沌神族”后裔，世代守护着古域，等待“青莲之主”的出现。族长“苍玄”眼中含泪：“圣物苏醒，吾族复兴有望！传令下去，举族前往秦家庄园，拜见主上！”
第1500章满天遍野的窥探
与此同时，在二十八重天的“万魔窟”深处，一尊被锁链穿透身躯、镇压了亿万年的魔影缓缓睁开眼睛，声音沙哑而贪婪：
“混沌青莲……混沌莲子……哈哈哈哈！只要吞了它，本尊就能冲破封印，重掌魔道！秦延军？不过是个暂时的宿主罢了，待本尊取了莲子，便将你炼化成我的养料！”
一股恐怖的魔威透过封印弥漫开来，整个万魔窟的凶兽都发出了不安的嘶吼。
三十三重天之上，一处悬浮于云端的宫殿中，一位身着朴素道袍、面容模糊的老者（天道圣人“玄黄老祖”）透过水镜看着秦家庄园的混沌青莲，眉头微蹙：
“混沌源力，本是宇宙初开之物，不应出现在此界……此子，究竟是变数，还是定数？”他身旁的童子轻声道：“老师，是否需要出手干预？”
玄黄老祖摇了摇头：“且看。若他能掌控混沌，未必不能成为新的‘秩序守护者’；若他被混沌吞噬，届时再清理不迟。”
二十八重天的水，远比秦延军想象的更深。
那些蛰伏了亿万年的古老存在，如同棋盘后的棋手，早已注意到了这颗突然落下的“混沌棋子”。他们的动作，或明或暗，却都指向了秦延军和他的混沌青莲。
在二十八重天与二十九重天的空间夹缝中，存在着一个神秘的“时空驿站”，驿站的主人是一位身着灰袍、面无表情的老者，人称“摆渡人”。
他既非神也非魔，更非仙，而是诞生于时空法则本身的古老存在，负责维护诸天万界的时空秩序，不偏不倚。
当秦延军使用“世界投影”探查二十八重天全貌时，摆渡人便已察觉。
他并未阻止，只是坐在驿站的青石板上，手中把玩着一枚刻满星图的罗盘，罗盘指针始终指向秦家庄园的方向。
“以凡人之躯，逆伐成神，如今又得混沌青莲……有趣，有趣。”摆渡人喃喃自语，“你的‘世界投影’，已触碰到时空法则的边缘，再进一步，便会引来‘时空乱流’的反噬。也罢，看在你这颗‘变数’或许能打破沉寂的份上，送你一份‘见面礼’。”
他屈指一弹，一枚晶莹的“时空沙”从罗盘上脱落，化作一道流光，悄无声息地融入秦延军的混沌球中。
秦延军此刻正在修炼《混沌源典》，并未察觉，但他的“世界投影”能力却在无形中变得更加稳定，探查范围也扩大了数倍，甚至能隐约看到一些被时空掩盖的远古遗迹。
二十八重天的“陨神渊”，传说中是上古神魔大战的战场，埋葬了无数强者和神器。
渊底深处，一座由万件残破神器残骸堆砌而成的宫殿中，一个身披战甲、面容威严的残魂（上古器灵之主“FOrgeMaSter”）正盯着一面由破碎镜片组成的镜子，镜子中映照的正是秦延军和混沌青莲。
这么多强大、古老的存在，都盯着秦家庄园，秦延军要怎么面对呢？一家四口能应付的过来吗？又会有什么样的变数？目前不得而知！

Chapter 1500 Spying all over the place
The Chaos Green Lotus is rooted in the center of the Qin family manor. On the lotus platform, the Chaos Lotus Seed is not still.
After Qin Yanjun nourished it with the power of the Chaos Ball, and instilled it with the rich spiritual energy of heaven and earth from the twenty-eighth heaven, the chaotic airflow on the surface of the lotus seed became more active, and there was a faint pulsation, as if a sleeping heart was slowly waking up.
On this day, Qin Yanjun was deducing the deeper application of "World Projection" when he suddenly felt something in his heart and looked towards the center of the manor.
I saw the chaotic energy around Chaos Qinglian rushing towards the lotus seed like a tide, and a tiny crack opened on the surface of the lotus seed.
A ray of golden light, thinner than a hair, shot out from it, suspended in mid-air, and transformed into a palm-sized shadow of a child whose entire body was condensed from chaotic energy.
The shadow opened its eyes in confusion and looked around curiously. Finally, its eyes fell on Qin Yanjun, and he shouted in a sweet voice: "Father?"
Qin Yanjun's mind was shaken. He could clearly feel the blood-like connection between himself and the child's shadow, and he could even sense the pure and ultimate source of chaos in the other person's body.
He instantly understood that this was the "Green Lotus Spirit" bred from the Chaos Lotus Seeds. Because he had been nourished by the Chaos Balls for a long time and integrated with his will, spiritual intelligence was actually born!
"From now on, you will be called 'Qin Qing'." Qin Yanjun said gently, his eyes full of relief.
Qin Qing chuckled and turned into a stream of light and merged into Qinglian. Qinglian's aura suddenly surged, and the chaotic energy it exuded became purer. It even began to spontaneously sort out the aura of heaven and earth around the manor, forming a huge vortex of aura.
The birth of Qin Qing not only gave him an extra partner, but also brought about secrets deep in the Chaos Qinglian.
As Qin Qing's spiritual wisdom gradually opened up, he began to intermittently pass on some information to Qin Yanjun - those were memory fragments recorded by Chaos Qinglian from the beginning of Chaos.
Among them, the most precious one is a fragment of martial arts called "The Origin of Chaos". It is not a specific move, but a perception of the "Law of Chaos": how to use yourself as chaos to evolve all things; how to use the power of chaos to defeat all laws; how to breed vitality in destruction...
Qin Yanjun practiced the "Chaos Origin Code", and the bottleneck of the Ancient God King Realm showed signs of loosening.
He sat under the green lotus, surrounded by chaotic air currents, sometimes turning into stars in the universe, sometimes turning into mountains and vegetation. The divine power and chaotic energy in his body blended, and he faintly touched the threshold of the "Tianzun Realm" - that is a realm that transcends the God King Realm and masters some of the original laws of the universe!
In addition, Qin Qing also informed Qin Yanjun that the deep roots of the Chaos Green Lotus are connected to a tributary of the "Chaos Source River". If it can be fully activated, the Qin family manor will have a steady stream of chaos energy, and even a small world can evolve.
But activating the source river requires the "Chaos Core" as the key, and this core is scattered in an ancient secret realm in the twenty-eighth heaven.
The abnormal movement of the Chaos Qinglian, especially the wisp of chaos origin aura that escaped when Qin Qing was born, was like throwing a huge boulder on a calm lake, instantly spreading throughout the twenty-eighth heaven, even alarming higher-level beings.
In the far west of the twenty-eighth sky, in an "ancient realm of chaos" wrapped in the turbulence of time and space, a group of tribesmen with blue-black skin and wings of chaos on their backs suddenly knelt down and worshiped on the ground.
They are the descendants of the "Chaos Gods" who survived the ancient Chaos War. They have guarded the ancient domain for generations, waiting for the emergence of the "Lord of Green Lotus". The patriarch "Cang Xuan" had tears in his eyes: "The sacred object has been revived, and there is hope for the revival of our clan! Send the order, and the whole clan will go to the Qin family manor to pay homage to the Lord!"
Chapter 1500 Spying all over the place
At the same time, deep in the "Ten Thousand Demons' Cave" on the twenty-eighth level, a demon shadow that had been pierced by chains and suppressed for hundreds of millions of years slowly opened its eyes, its voice was hoarse and greedy.:
"Chaos Green Lotus... Chaos Lotus Seed... Hahaha! As long as I swallow it, I can break through the seal and regain control of the devil! Qin Yanjun? You are just a temporary host. When I take the lotus seeds, I will refine you into my nourishment!"
A terrifying demonic power spread through the seal, and the beasts throughout the Ten Thousand Demons Cave roared uneasily.
Above the thirty-third heaven, in a palace suspended in the clouds, an old man with a vague face wearing a simple Taoist robe (the sage of heaven "Xuanhuang Patriarch") looked at the chaotic green lotus in the Qin family manor through the water mirror, frowning slightly:
"The source of chaos is the first thing in the universe and should not appear in this world... Is this child a variable or a certainty?" The boy beside him whispered: "Teacher, do you need to intervene?"
Ancestor Xuanhuang shook his head: "Let's see. If he can control Chaos, he may not be able to become the new 'Guardian of Order'; if he is swallowed by Chaos, it will not be too late to clean him up."
The water in the twenty-eighth heaven is far deeper than Qin Yanjun imagined.
Those ancient beings that have been dormant for hundreds of millions of years, like the chess players behind the chessboard, have already noticed this "chaos chess piece" that suddenly fell. Their actions, either overtly or covertly, pointed to Qin Yanjun and his Chaos Qinglian.
In the space between the twenty-eighth and twenty-ninth heavens, there is a mysterious "time and space station". The owner of the station is an expressionless old man in gray robe, known as the "ferryman".
He is neither a god nor a demon, nor an immortal, but an ancient existence born from the laws of time and space itself. He is responsible for maintaining the order of time and space in all heavens and worlds, and is impartial.
When Qin Yanjun used "World Projection" to explore the entire twenty-eighth sky, the ferryman was already aware of it.
He didn't stop him, he just sat on the bluestone board of the inn, playing with a compass full of star charts in his hand. The compass pointer always pointed in the direction of the Qin family manor.
"With a mortal body, he turned against the enemy and became a god, and now he has the Chaos Green Lotus... Interesting, interesting." The ferryman murmured to himself, "Your 'world projection' has touched the edge of the laws of time and space. If you go further, it will cause the backlash of the 'turbulent flow of time and space'. Anyway, because your 'variable' may be able to break the silence, I will give you a 'meeting gift'."
He flicked his finger, and a crystal "sand of time and space" fell off the compass, turned into a stream of light, and silently merged into Qin Yanjun's chaotic ball.
Qin Yanjun was practicing the "Chaos Source Code" at the moment and did not notice it, but his "World Projection" ability had become more stable invisibly, and the detection range had expanded several times, and he could even vaguely see some ancient ruins obscured by time and space.
The "Meteor God Abyss" in the twenty-eighth heaven is said to be the battlefield of the ancient war between gods and demons, where countless powerful men and artifacts are buried.
Deep in the abyss, in a palace made of tens of thousands of broken artifacts, a majestic remnant soul (the Lord of Ancient Artifact Spirits "FOrgeMaSter") wearing battle armor is staring at a mirror made of broken lenses. What is reflected in the mirror is Qin Yanjun and Chaos Qinglian.
With so many powerful and ancient beings staring at the Qin family manor, how will Qin Yanjun face them? Can a family of four cope with it? What kind of variables will there be? It’s currently unknown!
